info.name: Shared background Excel exports
info.description:
Shared background Excel exports (local implementation; not deployed by this change).

Set base_url to local_base_url, uat_base_url or production_base_url after the feature is installed. Fill API-KEY, token and requester with valid credentials. Optional Origin-API-Key uses the existing authorized origin-key flow; enable that header only when appropriate. Both Excel and base endpoint permissions apply. No credentials are provided here and this collection has no automatic scripts.

The request runs the existing base action once with exactly the same request, filters, pagination, defaults, ordering and calculations. Supplied page/data_size are honored exactly as the base action honors them; omission does not mean export-all. Some summary actions do not paginate. Optional query parameters are disabled in these examples; enable only those needed. Required branch/date selectors are enabled where applicable. Base errors and no-results responses are propagated, with no job created. A successful empty base response still exports.

HTTP 200 means queued, not ready. Save export_id and status_url from the response manually, then poll GET /exports/get_status using the same authenticated user or the same valid origin-key context. Requester alone is not proof of ownership. Status is queued, running, ready or failed; ownership failures return 404. The promised file_url is a direct static URL on the API application domain, stays unchanged, and returns 404 until local publication completes. Anyone possessing the file URL can download it without authentication. Download it directly; do not use the VM4 file proxy. Download only after status=ready. Completed workbooks and status metadata expire 24 hours after queuing and are pruned during subsequent export/status operations. Cleanup is opportunistic; a static URL can remain usable beyond 24 hours until pruning runs. No automatic worker retries: after failure, investigate and submit a new export request if appropriate.

Workbook: Summary holds response metadata (counts, pagination, dates, totals) and table references. Data holds flat main rows. Separate root report tables, nested objects and nested lists receive their own worksheets, with internal worksheet links and four leading export columns for row ID, parent ID, original index and source path. Original source field names follow. If a source field conflicts with an export header, only the export header receives an extra underscore. Source order and array indexes are retained. Null is an explicit empty XML cell; a missing field has no cell. Zero, booleans, Unicode, leading zeros and numeric-looking strings retain their types; formula-like strings are text. Native numbers are numeric. Integers longer than Excel’s 15-digit precision also have exact text copies on Numeric_values. Rows/columns beyond worksheet limits use _rN/_cN continuation sheets, repeating parent references. Long_text contains ordered chunks for values exceeding the 32767 UTF-16-unit cell limit; join by parent row ID, worksheet, cell and part. No values are silently truncated.

The worker renders a private response snapshot and publishes on the application VM under assets/exports/excel/<environment-namespace>/<export_id>/<file_name>. It never re-runs report queries, stores request credentials, or calls VM4. A randomly named staging copy is checked for matching SHA-256 and valid XLSX structure before atomic publication. Publication failures produce failed and remove incomplete output. A completed file missing from disk no longer reports ready. Private snapshots and temporary workbooks are deleted on completion/failure; expired public files and metadata are pruned by later export/status calls. Before rollout, verify application base URL, private/public storage permissions, CLI runtime and static file serving. No deployment is included.

All saved responses are illustrative. reports/get_payment_terms does not exist: its Excel equivalent intentionally returns HTTP 400 with “base endpoint doesnt exist”; this collection does not create a JSON endpoint.
